## Description
Brief summary of the architectural changes, bug fixes, or enhancements.

## Type of Change
- [ ] Bug fix (non-breaking change fixing an issue)
- [ ] New feature (non-breaking change adding functionality)
- [ ] Breaking change (fix or feature causing existing functionality to change)
- [ ] Security patch / Vulnerability mitigation

## Quality Checklist
- [ ] All unit and integration tests pass (`make test`).
- [ ] Concurrency guarantees verified (no negative stock).
- [ ] Financial calculations adhere to integer santim.
- [ ] No secrets or sensitive keys committed.
